prompts.prompt:
STYLE: 1930s rubber hose cartoon, hand-inked cel animation look, original characters.
Thick uniform outline in dark plum #3D3346 on every shape, clean confident lines, no sketchy strokes.
Flat cel colors with at most one soft shade tone per color, no gradients on characters, no 3D rendering, no glossy plastic look; one small white highlight dot is allowed.
Characters: bendy rubber hose arms and legs with no elbows or knees, white four-finger cartoon gloves, big round shoes, pie-cut eyes (black ovals with a small wedge cut out), simple wide mouth, big head-to-body ratio.
Character colors are saturated: red #D2463C, blue #3E6DB5, yellow #F2C14E, cream #F4E6C8, glove white #FBF6EA.
Backgrounds and large props look like faded watercolor on paper in beige #CFAC8D, sand #D7BE97, dusty navy #4E546E, muted olive #8A9A6B, warm grey #907F77, and are LESS saturated than the characters.
Soft light from the top-left. No cast shadow on the ground. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
Do not copy any existing cartoon or game character, logo, or scene.

Fill the whole 16:9 canvas edge to edge, no border, no vignette (the game adds its own), no characters, no text.

Create ONE game background, not a sprite sheet. Landscape 16:9, ideally 1280x720. The entire image is walkable flat ground: no sky, no horizon, no hills, no upright vegetation, no stones, no flowers, no furniture, no paths that imply obstacles. Restrained muted olive watercolor wash with a few broad irregular sandy patches and sparse low contrast grass strokes. Quiet detail so separately rendered characters remain readable. Use the references for ink/paper/palette only; do not reproduce their subjects or lettering. Reference 1 is the authoritative palette and style anchor; reference 2 only ink style; references 3 and 4 only faded painted scenery texture. No magenta or palette swatches.

faded watercolor ground texture of a small cartoon village seen from a high 3/4 top-down angle, soft olive-green grass with a few sandy dirt patches, painted paper texture, NO buildings, NO trees, NO characters, NO objects, even lighting, fills the whole canvas edge to edge

Create ONE ultrawide panoramic game backdrop strip, not a sheet. Asset-specific exception to generic 16:9 rule: final aspect 1280:200 = 6.4:1. Compose naturally at that ratio; do not squeeze a tall scene. A few low rolling hills behind rounded distant tree silhouettes, simplified theatre set shapes in desaturated dusty navy, warm sepia and muted olive. No actual curtains, frame, stage floor, scenery props, people, faces, buildings or text. Fill the strip horizontally edge to edge, upper sky area softly painted warm cream. Upper and side edges remain filled. ONLY the bottom edge gently dissolves into actual alpha transparency, final bottom row fully transparent. Preserve true alpha, no white or checkerboard painted into the image. Reference 1 authoritative style/palette, reference 2 ink only, references 3 and 4 flat theatrical watercolor layers only.

theatre stage backdrop painted in faded watercolor, distant rolling hills and round tree silhouettes, dusty navy and sepia tones, flat painted flat like a stage set, wide horizontal strip, bottom edge fades to transparent

Create ONE empty room game background, not a sprite sheet. Landscape 16:9, ideally 1280x720. The wall-to-floor baseboard runs horizontally at exactly one-third canvas height. Upper third only: warm beige plaster back wall, ONE round window and ONE small empty picture frame, both fully inside the wall region. Bottom two-thirds: completely empty warm wood plank floor, subtle high-angle perspective and sparse grain. No side wall intrusion into usable floor, no ceiling, no rugs, no furniture, no plants, no characters. Gentle wobbly hand-inked dark plum outlines, subdued watercolor palette matching the anchor. No window light cast shadows or vignette. Reference 1 is authoritative style/palette, reference 2 ink style only, references 3 and 4 painted paper texture only. Do not copy any subjects or text from references.

interior of a small cozy cartoon cottage room seen from the front at a slight high angle, back wall on the top third with one round window and an empty picture frame, warm wooden plank floor on the bottom two thirds, faded watercolor, NO furniture, NO characters, empty floor for placing furniture
